Greek Pi Symbol Symbol

There is no legacy Windows Alt code for Greek Pi Symbol because it is not in either the OEM code page 437 or Windows-1252 tables. The Unicode codepoint is U+03D6, which you can use as ϖ in HTML, \03D6 in CSS, or type with Alt+982 on Windows (BMP only). If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly. Greek Pi Symbol is outside both legacy code pages, which is why U+03D6 is the identifier that works across Word, HTML, CSS, Python and JavaScript. HTML also defines the named entity ϖ for Greek Pi Symbol, but the numeric form ϖ is safer when compatibility is uncertain.

How to type greek pi symbol on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 9 8 2 on the numeric keypad for the decimal codepoint 982.
  4. Release Alt. The Greek Pi Symbol character (ϖ) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type greek pi symbol on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Greek Pi Symbol. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Greek Pi Symbol" and click the character to insert it.

How to use greek pi symbol in code

  • HTML: or , also
  • CSS: content:"\03D6"; ()
  • Python: \u03D6 or chr(0x3D6)
  • JavaScript: \u03D6 or String.fromCodePoint(0x3D6)
  • JSON: "\u03D6"

Frequently asked questions

Is there an Alt code for ϖ?

No legacy Alt code exists for Greek Pi Symbol because it is not in code page 437 or Windows-1252. Use the Unicode codepoint U+03D6 in HTML, CSS or the Character Viewer instead.

How do I type ϖ without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as ϖ, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+982 not work?

Alt+982 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Greek Pi Symbol?

The Unicode codepoint for Greek Pi Symbol is U+03D6. You can use this value in HTML as ϖ, in CSS as \03D6, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type ϖ on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+03D6, then click it.
